item.title: Root Cause Correlation (Pro)
item.description: A vulnerable library pulled into forty services produces forty Findings. Each one is real, each one is separately triaged, and each one is fixed by the same single version bump. Root Cause Correlation makes that relationship explicit: DefectDojo Pro groups Findings that share a root cause into a ranked list of Root Causes, so you can see the one fix and everything it clears.
